# Security policy

FolioDash is at the architecture-draft stage. No application, backend or deployment exists yet, so there is nothing running to attack and no supported release.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report privately through GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/AlbiDR/FolioDash/security/advisories/new), once the repository is public and the feature is enabled. Do not open a public issue.

Never include tokens, bank statements, holdings, account identifiers or other personal financial data in a report. A description and synthetic reproduction steps are enough.

The security boundary is defined in [docs/architecture](../docs/architecture/cleanstack.md), not here.
